title: Laurentness and polynomiality under positive specialization of F-polynomials for generalized quantum cluster algebras
source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) article 080, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2024.080; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The author first constructs the noncommutative mutation factorization and the associated F-element without assuming polynomiality. The principal-coefficient embedding then turns Newton-polytope support into an integral-lattice assertion, and positive specialization prevents support shrinkage so that classical F-polynomial nonnegativity excludes negative exponents. The quantum mutation and support-control chain remains in the included author argument.
author: Changjian Fu; Liangang Peng; Huihui Ye
